title: LaunchDarkly Webhook Event
description: The payload delivered by LaunchDarkly webhooks when changes occur to resources. The format is identical to audit log entries.

_id.description: The unique identifier of this audit log event.

date.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the change occurred. Use this to reorder events since webhooks may arrive out of order.

kind.description: The kind of resource that was changed.

name.description: The name of the resource that was changed.

description.description: A markdown-formatted description of the changes made.

shortDescription.description: A brief plain-text summary of the change.

comment.description: An optional comment provided by the member who made the change.

accesses.description: The access details describing what action was taken on which resource.

titleVerb.description: The verb describing the action taken, such as created, updated, or deleted.

title.description: A human-readable title for the event.

name.description: The name of the target resource.

resources.description: The resource specifiers for the target.

Access.description: An access record describing what action was performed on which resource.

action.description: The action that was performed, such as createFlag, updateOn, deleteFlag, or updateTargets.

resource.description: A resource specifier in the format proj/{projKey}:env/{envKey}:flag/{flagKey}.

MemberRef.description: A reference to the account member who made the change.

_id.description: The unique identifier of the member.

email.description: The email address of the member.

firstName.description: The first name of the member.

lastName.description: The last name of the member.

href.description: The URL of the linked resource.

type.description: The media type of the linked resource.
